referenceFidelity.findings: The charcoal framed glass partitions and paired doors translate photographed office meeting-room fronts with broad pale privacy bands instead of tiny decals.

construction.findings: Main vertical frame members now terminate between top/bottom rails instead of overlapping their outer end faces. Central paired-door mullion was extended to meet the transom and leaf panes fitted to the resulting aperture. Handles have deliberate depth and clear frames.

readability.findings: Pale bands and wood handles make the glazed doors recognizable at phone width; charcoal frames rely on the light wood/stucco interior context and appear lower contrast against the Inspector dark background.

motion.findings: Deliberately static environment architecture, no skeleton or authored clips.

secondPass.findings: Rechecked current rebuilt front/rear/oblique and phone after frame-junction repair. Central mullion no longer floats below the top rail; only fitted corner feet project and the privacy bands align.

userAcceptance.note: User authorized creation but has not explicitly accepted this model revision.

limitations: Original interpreted campus architecture; complete measured GitHub as-built CAD documentation was not found.
Dark frames need a light interior background for strongest contrast; the pale bands and handles remain legible on the dark Inspector background.
